selectionCore.milestone: M3 selection projections over the unchanged M2 core
selectionCore.scope: Ten fixed design-case selection projections and independent synthetic core/CLI tests; no execution, CI integration, provider or end-to-end acceptance claim. r05 is delegated to plan tests. Original M1 coverage fields and six partial-unit statuses remain unchanged.
selectionCore.comparison: Approved 2026-10-20: status and exitCode exact; selectedInstanceIds exact set with duplicate rejection. Expected notSelectedInstanceIds are forbidden examples: every ID must be declared in the input model universe, unique, and absent from selected IDs. They need not exhaust actual omissions or appear in an early rejection partition. Actual output lists also reject duplicates and undeclared IDs. Separate synthetic tests enforce deterministic output order.
selectionCore.adaptation: Only fixtureModels and given are used to build input. Explicit checks_by_component replaces componentInstances, while inherited components and owners remain. CamelCase and snake_case changed paths, impact edges and canonical-scope inputs are translated without reading expected. c03 execution target/localAllowed are outside this pure selection projection and are not claimed tested. expected is read only by the oracle. All extracted source execution labels remain not-run.
selectionCore.negativeControls: Fifteen explicit wrong-input/model fault tests, including all five newly activated c-case controls, plus oracle-sensitivity and safe CLI error injection tests. The generic c-case fault is instantiated at the required-instance or policy boundary. c07 deliberately grants an unapproved full fallback in its mutant only. The exact r09 cross-repository-execution fault remains UNEXECUTED because the adapter has no repository traversal or execution interface. These demonstrate sensitivity to concrete faults, not an exhaustive production-code mutation score or runtime safety proof.

cases.note: Exact status/exitCode/selected set; unchanged forbidden examples are declared and unselected. Full inherited component universe is retained. Negative control removes a required guard.

Exact status/exitCode/selected set for auth, userdata, family and mutation plus guards; unchanged forbidden examples are declared and unselected. GitHub-only local-execution policy, GitHub dispatch and downstream authorization tests remain outside this selection projection. Negative control drops the family consumer edge.

Exact status/exitCode/selected set includes generator, package, web and both CLI OS variants. Unchanged forbidden examples are declared and unselected. Negative control omits the required generator instance.

Negative control grants a complete full fallback despite explicit disapproval, producing plan-ready instead of blocked.
